card.architecture: Mage-Flow 4B native-resolution MMDiT (Mage-VAE + Qwen3-VL-4B encoder), 4-step distilled
card.summary: Few-step distilled Mage-Flow: 4 steps, cfg 1, ~0.6 s/image at 1024x1024 on an A100. Near-base quality for fast iteration and interactive previews; native resolution 512-2048, any aspect. No CFG / negative prompts.
card.pick_when: You want the fastest Mage-Flow -- 4-step previews and iteration. Give up CFG/negative control for speed.

prompt.guidance: Descriptive natural-language prose (Qwen3-VL encoder); English recommended. Distilled: cfg 1, 4 steps, no negative prompts.
prompt.example: Vintage analogue film photograph, a seated figure by a large wooden window with pale blue sky outside, soft daylight, muted retro pastel colours, subtle film grain, gentle haze, minimalist surreal photography, photorealistic
prompt.overview: The 4-step distilled Mage-Flow. Same rich natural-language prompting as the RL model, but runs without classifier-free guidance -- do not supply a negative prompt.
prompt.instructions: Write detailed natural-language descriptions (English recommended). Few-step distilled: set 4 steps and cfg 1, and do NOT use a negative prompt (no effect at cfg 1). Native resolution 512-2048 on any aspect ratio (multiples of 16).
do: Try wide/tall native aspect ratios (up to 4:1)
dont: Supply a negative prompt (no effect at cfg 1)
Raise cfg above 1 or exceed 2048 px
prompt.negative_guidance: Runs without CFG (cfg 1); negative prompts have no effect.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
ui_help.good_for: fast previews & everyday images at any aspect ratio
